translator.evidence: Original AI-assisted translation covers all 1,315 English source messages in 12 family slices; technical identifiers and fixed notation were retained where appropriate. Updated 2026-09-28 with 69 original messages for change review, agent questions, permission rules, connectors, background runs, research progress and budgets. Placeholders and locale-specific plural forms are preserved; no upstream translated text was copied.

reviewer.evidence: AI-assisted independent semantic review read all 1,315 Telugu messages across 12 slices for meaning, register, and script. Corrected chart saturation terminology, pan instructions, input/output token labels, chart annotation wording, and selected-overflow formatting; audited exact English-identical templates. This is not native-speaker certification. Updated 2026-09-28: an independent AI-assisted review checked all 69 added messages for meaning, UI register, terminology and placeholders, and corrected the catalog before this snapshot. The research-source count was checked against the pinned CLDR categories, including locale-specific decimal and non-singular forms. The complete 1,384-key snapshot was checked for key coverage, value kinds, placeholders and exact-English message paths; only individually justified new cognates, loanwords and technical names were retained. This increment does not claim a new linguistic review of all older messages, human review or native-speaker certification.
